projectsData.title: Gacad — Institutional Academic Core
projectsData.description: High-availability administrative web core for complete academic management: admissions, records, enrollment, and grade reports.
projectsData.longDescription: Centralized system that fully digitized institutional academic operations. Built on a decoupled architecture to guarantee high concurrency during mass-enrollment periods.
projectsData.problem: Manual academic processes and bottlenecks during simultaneous enrollment that caused server outages.
projectsData.decision: Adopted Clean Architecture and CQRS in C# .NET 8 with Angular, strictly separating reads (Queries) from writes (Commands).
projectsData.tradeoff: Higher upfront development time and conceptual overhead defining DTOs and Handlers, in exchange for scalability and fault isolation.
projectsData.impact: Sub-100ms response times on grade queries and 100% digitization with zero downtime across the last 4 academic terms.

projectsData.title: My ISTPET — Student Mobile App
projectsData.description: Official full-stack mobile app for the university community with live schedules, grades, payments, and a digital QR ID card.
projectsData.longDescription: Native/hybrid mobile platform giving instant access to student records, QR-verified digital ID, and payment gateway integration.
projectsData.problem: No direct channel for academic communication and record lookup while students were off campus.
projectsData.decision: Built the app in React Native with TypeScript, consuming a secured RESTful API in .NET 8 with local session caching.
projectsData.tradeoff: iOS/Android compatibility required rigorous re-render optimization and asset bundling.
projectsData.impact: +2,500 active downloads and a 70% reduction in in-person visits to the registrar's office.

projectsData.title: DebtManager — C# Desktop Finance Engine
projectsData.description: Native C# desktop app for personal finance control, amortization tracking, and offline debt management.
projectsData.longDescription: Performance-focused desktop tool with no network dependency. Includes French/German amortization calculators, interactive charts, and local relational persistence.
projectsData.problem: Privacy concerns and internet dependency in existing personal finance management apps.
projectsData.decision: Built a native C# .NET Desktop app with a locally encrypted SQLite persistence engine and LINQ.
projectsData.tradeoff: Limited to the desktop environment, in exchange for zero network latency and full user privacy.
projectsData.impact: Instant installment calculations and exportable financial reports with < 5ms response time.

projectsData.title: Education Microservices Architecture
projectsData.description: Distributed .NET 8 backend ecosystem with event-driven communication, CQRS, DDD, and container deployment on Docker and Kubernetes.
projectsData.longDescription: Distributed architecture design for mass learning platforms. Separates student analytics, adaptive exams, and the content catalog into independent services.
projectsData.problem: Educational monoliths collapsing under demand spikes during end-of-term exams.
projectsData.decision: Structured independent microservices in .NET 8 orchestrated on Kubernetes with hexagonal architecture and gRPC/REST contracts.
projectsData.tradeoff: Higher operational complexity and the need for distributed tracing, in exchange for complete fault isolation.
projectsData.impact: Full fault isolation: an analytics failure never interrupts exam-taking.

projectsData.title: Inventory Optimization (0/1 Knapsack)
projectsData.description: Java system solving the 0/1 Knapsack problem with dynamic programming, comparing 3 approaches.
projectsData.longDescription: Computational performance benchmark analyzing pure recursion, top-down memoization, and bottom-up tabulation on large datasets.
projectsData.problem: Exponential O(2^n) slowdown when computing optimal logistics inventory combinations.
projectsData.decision: Designed a dynamic-programming engine in Java, cutting time complexity to O(n*W).
projectsData.tradeoff: Higher O(n*W) memory usage, in exchange for going from minutes to milliseconds of execution.
projectsData.impact: Execution time optimized from ~45 seconds to 12 milliseconds on high-volume test data.

projectsData.title: SIAT / AVIALB — Ecuadorian National Police
projectsData.description: Specialized system for collecting, auditing, and analyzing traffic accidents for the Traffic Accident Investigation Service.
projectsData.longDescription: Government application standardizing police reports, roadside evidence collection, and generating official, auditable expert reports.
projectsData.problem: Scattered physical forms and lack of forensic traceability in traffic accident investigations.
projectsData.decision: Implemented modules in .NET Core and SQL Server with immutable audit trails and role-based access control (RBAC).
projectsData.tradeoff: Strict upfront validation requirements lengthened the forms, in exchange for legal security.
projectsData.impact: 100% standardization of institutional traffic expert reports with full legal validity.
